Message:
Through the window,
I gazed out at the sky,
which looked as if it would
pour down rain at any moment.

That’s what my
eldest sister asked me,
her parasol in hand.

She looked sad as she said it,
just like Mother did...

“No. I promised Mother
to stay indoors since
my health is poor, remember?”

My third eldest sister then
softly squeezed my hand,
and said...

“Today, I’ll tie your hair
with your favorite red ribbon,
Lillicotte...”

After that,
my second eldest sister
closed her pocket watch,
and poured tea into
each of our cups.

“The first time
you leave this house,
we’ll all go together.
We promise.”

Then, my sisters all hugged me.
Their embrace felt so warm,
it almost tickled.

Even if I can’t
leave the house yet,
I can handle it.
I have my mother and
my sisters here with me,
after all.
